operatorBackup.directory: operator-managed state directory outside the repository
operatorBackup.restoreRule: Copy all four files into infra/alchemy/.alchemy/state/vektor/dev-main, then run the repository wrapper. The wrapper verifies the three resource identities before Alchemy starts.

transfer.source: Cloudflare.state() for stack vektor and stage dev-main
transfer.method: Alchemy state export; select the three vektor-apex-* records; write each state payload as one LocalState record

dualControllerRisk.reason: The retained Cloudflare state records are stale after the local-state deployment.
dualControllerRisk.control: The repository stack maps dev-main only to LocalState, and the deployment wrapper requires the exact local record set before it can start Alchemy.
dualControllerRisk.operatorRule: Do not run a dev-main mutation through Cloudflare.state() or from the retained remote records.
